name: Parasut Invoicing
description: Issues a sales invoice in Parasut for every paid order, using the invoice details the checkout collected.
author: Blysis

settingsCards.title: Parasut Invoicing
settingsCards.description: Credentials for issuing a sales invoice on every paid order.

api.description: The sales that could not be invoiced, and why (admin).
Send the e-document for one recorded sale, or read where it got to.

parasutInvoicing.adm_subtitle: Every paid order becomes a sales invoice. Until this is filled in, the checkout asks nobody for invoice details.
parasutInvoicing.adm_companyIdDesc: The number in the address bar when you are signed in to your company.
parasutInvoicing.adm_usernameDesc: The account the invoices are issued by.
parasutInvoicing.adm_owingNone: Every recorded sale has an approved document.
parasutInvoicing.adm_sendConfirmTitle: Send this to the tax authority?
parasutInvoicing.adm_sendConfirm: A document the authority accepts is cancelled by a procedure, not by deleting it here.
parasutInvoicing.adm_error_not_configured: The accounting service is not set up yet.
parasutInvoicing.adm_error_not_found: There is no invoice record for that order.
parasutInvoicing.adm_error_not_recorded: That sale is not in the accounting service yet.
parasutInvoicing.adm_error_already_requested: A document has already been asked for.

parasutInvoicing.adm_subtitle: Ödenen her sipariş bir satış faturasına dönüşür. Burası doldurulmadan checkout kimseden fatura bilgisi istemez.
parasutInvoicing.adm_companyIdDesc: Firmanızda oturum açtığınızda adres çubuğunda görünen numara.
parasutInvoicing.adm_owingNone: Kaydedilen her satışın onaylanmış bir belgesi var.
parasutInvoicing.adm_sendConfirmTitle: Bu belge vergi idaresine gönderilsin mi?
parasutInvoicing.adm_sendConfirm: İdarenin kabul ettiği bir belge, burada silinerek değil bir işlemle iptal edilir.
parasutInvoicing.adm_error_not_recorded: O satış henüz muhasebe servisinde değil.
parasutInvoicing.adm_error_already_requested: Bu satış için zaten belge istendi.

settings.label: Send the e-document automatically
settings.description: Ask the tax authority for the e-Fatura or e-Arsiv a recorded sale is owed. Off until you turn it on: such a document is cancelled by a procedure, not deleted.
